capabilities: Rotate open tabs to the right or left
Set the rotation interval in seconds
Start and stop rotation via ribbon icon or commands
Choose rotating one tab or all splits in the main window
extras: README references a demo video that is not included in the text; settings are described only by location (Settings > Community Plugins > Tab Rotator).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically cycle through open tabs, so reviewing many opened files means clicking each tab by hand.
summary: Auto-rotation plugin that cycles through open tabs left or right at a set interval, instead of clicking through each opened file manually.
